source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega recording; background replaced by Segment Anything 2 - only table and ball kept)
frame_time_rule: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); t=0 is frame 0, last frame 48 = 2.000 s

camera.motion: static (table mask shift vs frame 0 < 1 px in every frame; no pan or shake)

intrinsics_from_benchmark.note: f = 0.5959 x 1280; principal point assumed at image centre

camera.view: slightly elevated view looking at a table from its long front side; table top seen in perspective as a trapezoid (front edge long and low, back edge short and higher). No horizon visible (background replaced).

objects.name: ball
objects.description: yellow-green tennis ball; the only moving object
objects.reference_point: cx, cy = centroid of the colour mask (visible centre)

apparent_diameter_px.frames_0_16_held_near_camera: tangential ~95 (radial ~115, stretched by off-axis perspective, ball at ~35 deg off-axis)
apparent_diameter_px.best_size_column: diam_tangential_px (perspective-robust); diam_radial_px is inflated by off-axis stretch and, in frames 17-22, by motion blur

objects.name: table
objects.description: brown wood-grain rectangular table top on a single dark central pedestal leg; static
objects.note: front-right corner hidden behind the ball in frames 0-18; fully visible from frame 20

objects.name: table_leg
objects.description: dark grey pedestal column under the table centre with a black mounting bracket

events.event: ball held/resting near the camera at the table's front-right corner, small jitter only (<= 6 px)
start of motion (release/push) - ball starts moving up-left
events.note: slow drift left from frame ~13 (steps 2, 4, 6 px at 13->14, 14->15, 15->16), 9 px at 16->17, then 44 px at 17->18; onset range frames 13-17

events.event: fast phase with motion blur, ball passes over the table's front-right corner onto the table top
ball recedes (shrinks) diagonally toward the back of the table

direction change: farthest point / smallest apparent size; image motion turns from up-left to left and slightly down, size starts growing (ball comes back toward the camera). Likely rebound off something at the back (erased by the background replacement) or curve
probable dropped capture frame: image step 35->36 is ~20.5 px vs ~10.5 px for neighbours (timestamps in file are uniform)
ball still rolling left along the back of the table at the end of the clip (~10 px/frame)
